info.name: Yasuho cuteee theme!!
info.description:
A soft, elegant theme inspired by Yasuho Hirose from JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: JoJolion.
Featuring pastel pinks, lavender tones, and rose accents—this aesthetic captures Yasuho’s peaceful, stylish, and caring personality.
Perfect for fans who want their browsing experience to feel like a page from the manga.
